osteometric_data.description: Long-bone maximum lengths as a function of stature via published forensic regression equations (stature = a * bone_length + b, cm). Inverted to obtain bone length for a given stature.

metadata.notes: Male white equations from Trotter (1970), a revision of Trotter & Gleser (1952, 1958). Female white and female Black equations from Trotter & Gleser (1952:495), verified 2026-09-29. Coefficients are for maximum bone length (osteometric board), which is longer than the joint-centre distance used by human_adult_206.json; therefore these values drive bone MESH extents, not joint positions. Historical forensic series labels are not character-appearance presets.

male_white.population: US white males, 18-30 y (WWII / Korean War casualties)

female_white.population: US white females (Terry Collection); Trotter & Gleser 1952 Table p.495
female_white.notes: Verified 2026-09-29 against Trotter & Gleser 1952 as tabulated in osteology textbooks (e.g. GVSU Intro to Human Osteology, citing 1952:495 / 1977:355). These are forensic stature-from-bone equations for a historical series, not appearance or ethnicity parameters. Trotter (1970) revised *male* equations; female formulae remain the 1952 set.

female_black.population: US Black females (Terry Collection); Trotter & Gleser 1952 Table p.495
female_black.notes: Same table as female_white. Historical forensic series labels; not a character-appearance preset. Used only if osteometric_population is set to female_black.

male_white_180.derivation: bone_length = (stature_cm - b) / a, male_white, stature 180 cm

female_white_165.derivation: bone_length = (stature_cm - b) / a, female_white, stature 165 cm

shaft_diameters.notes: Midshaft diameters used only for proxy bone meshes. Not sourced; replace with osteometric tables (e.g. Terry/Hamann-Todd collections) when acquired.

TROTTER_1970.citation: Trotter, M. (1970). Estimation of stature from intact long limb bones. In T.D. Stewart (Ed.), Personal Identification in Mass Disasters (pp. 71-83). Smithsonian Institution.

TROTTER_GLESER_1952.citation: Trotter, M. & Gleser, G.C. (1952). Estimation of stature from long bones of American Whites and Negroes. American Journal of Physical Anthropology, 10(4), 463-514.

TROTTER_GLESER_1958.citation: Trotter, M. & Gleser, G.C. (1958). A re-evaluation of estimation of stature based on measurements of stature taken during life and of long bones after death. American Journal of Physical Anthropology, 16(1), 79-123.
